title: Specimen
description: Tumor-type and specimen context for a single NGS interpretation response. Aligns with the FHIR R5 Specimen resource and FHIR Genomics Specimen profile, retaining only fields that travel with a vendor report and are needed for downstream interpretation. Patient identifiers are out of scope: the interpretation pipeline is stateless, not a record store.

specimenId.description: Vendor-issued specimen identifier (lab accession, kit ID). Opaque to the pipeline.

specimenType.description: Specimen substrate. FFPE is the dominant tissue substrate for solid tumor CGP; cfDNA from plasma is the dominant liquid biopsy substrate.

primaryTumorSite.description: Anatomical site of the primary tumor. The contract prefers SNOMED CT but accepts ICD-O-3 topography or a free-text display when a code is not available in the source report.

snomedCode.description: SNOMED CT concept ID for the tumor site (e.g., '39607008' for lung structure).

icdo3Topography.description: ICD-O-3 topography code (e.g., 'C34.1' upper lobe lung).

display.description: Human-readable tumor site label (e.g., 'Lung, upper lobe'; 'Endometrium').

histology.description: Histologic diagnosis. ICD-O-3 morphology is preferred; SNOMED CT is acceptable when the source report does not carry an ICD-O code.

icdo3Morphology.description: ICD-O-3 morphology/behavior code (e.g., '8140/3' for adenocarcinoma NOS).

snomedCode.description: Optional SNOMED CT code for the histologic diagnosis.

display.description: Human-readable histology label (e.g., 'Lung adenocarcinoma'; 'Invasive mammary carcinoma'; 'Endometrioid carcinoma NOS').

specimenSite.description: Where the specimen itself was collected, when different from the primary tumor site (e.g., metastasis biopsy: 'Liver' for a pancreas primary).

collectionDate.description: ISO 8601 date when the specimen was collected from the patient.

receivedDate.description: ISO 8601 date when the lab received the specimen.

tumorContent.description: Estimated tumor cellularity of the specimen as a percentage (0–100). Drives confidence in low-VAF variant calls.

ctdnaTumorFraction.description: Liquid biopsy: estimated fraction of plasma cell-free DNA derived from tumor. High tumor fraction reduces the false-negative risk of liquid-biopsy variant calls.
